nativeFixes: Apply moderation directly to peer receivers and verify native engine state, rather than relying on cached stream flags.
Keep app busy until capture teardown finishes after a kick.
Project-local WebRTC weak-renderer guards prevent queued frame callbacks dereferencing a disposed renderer; shared package cache unchanged.
compatibility: Old apps retain ordinary calls/groups and unmuted recurring meetings; an enforced mute requires updated receivers, with an update message for older clients.
limitations: TURN disabled; networks requiring media relays may not connect.
Off-VM backup is a snapshot, not automatically scheduled.
